text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp starts today! In a 
special environment, it's time to tackle a 
menu aimed at intensive reinforcement!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean, we were on the bus for super long, 
you know? It was rocking and swaying the 
whole entire time...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Uuuggghhh... This is why I hate the 
bus~~...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying Sweep Tosho's luggage to her room 
for her after seeing her look 
uncharacteristically timid, I sat down to 
draft the training camp schedule starting 
tomorrow.
